solutions.explanation: After multiplying by \((2-1)=1\), apply the difference of squares formula repeatedly to obtain \(2^{16}-1=65535\).
solutions.title: Successive differences of squares

solutions.explanation:
The powers are small enough to evaluate each factor directly. The four factors are \(3\), \(5\), \(17\), and \(257\), so multiplying in order gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
3\cdot5\cdot17\cdot257
&=15\cdot17\cdot257\\
&=255\cdot257\\
&=65535.
\end{aligned}
\]
Thus the value is \(65535\).
solutions.title: Evaluate the factors and multiply
